items.quote: Fear of the cold calling is deeply rooted in your, um I would say in your disability to look bad in front of other people. And let me ask you this, you don't want to make cold calls, probably in front of your colleagues, because you don't want to look stupid.
items.statement: Fear of the cold calling is deeply rooted in your disability to look bad in front of other people.

items.quote: Your uh next couple of years of career success will depend on the quantity of calls you do daily.
items.statement: Your next couple of years of career success will depend on the quantity of calls you do daily.

items.quote: Why would you care about people who don't know you that well, who literally gonna forget you uh in two, three minutes after you put the phone down.
items.statement: You might care too much about how people perceive you during cold calls, but they will forget you quickly.

overview: Transcript from a YouTube short discussing overcoming the fear of cold calling.
